freshness.basis: sessions are weekdays minus the exchange holidays learned from days with no published file; future holidays are unknown; a session's file is expected after 18:30 IST

jobs.description: Alert if there is no valid Kite session before the feed starts (the login is manual)
jobs.name: kite-login-reminder

jobs.description: Load the daily bhavcopy; retries every 10 min for 2 h until the newest bar is current
jobs.name: bhavcopy-daily

jobs.description: Alert on a quarantined bhavcopy, an open weekday with no daily bars, or a session with under 90% of the usual number of bars (after the retries and the gap sweep have had their chance)
jobs.name: data-completeness

jobs.description: Alert when a regulatory rule live trading needs (order-rate limit, order types, tagging, static IP) is not recorded or was last verified over 30 days ago: live stays blocked until it is checked and recorded again
jobs.name: regulatory-check

jobs.description: Before the market opens: INITIALIZING -> DATA_VALIDATION -> READY -> PAPER, each step recorded, only if the daily data is current, a Kite session exists and the order log, orders and positions all agree; alerts when the platform does not reach PAPER (a strategy then cannot propose while ALGO_REQUIRE_PLATFORM_READY=1)
jobs.name: platform-boot

jobs.description: Every minute in market hours: alert when a process that should be running (the live feed, and the study worker where it is expected) has never reported, gone silent, is degraded or has stopped
jobs.name: heartbeat-check

jobs.description: The evening decision for every enabled paper account on the newest session, each strategy in its sandboxed worker (after the data jobs and checks; a run that cannot decide, or errors, alerts; a strategy that breaks a rule is halted and paused); proposals wait for the owner's approval
jobs.name: paper-run

jobs.description: Every five minutes in market hours: fill approved paper orders at the next live open (needs the live feed) and expire the ones that ran out of time
jobs.name: paper-orders

jobs.description: Every minute in market hours and once after the close (the half-minute keeps it clear of paper-orders): close the positions of an account whose kill switch is FLATTEN, then check the OMS log, the paper orders and the book against each other; a mismatch pauses the strategy and alerts
jobs.name: paper-reconcile

jobs.description: Materialise every USABLE feature month by month against the newest data freeze; completed months are skipped, a paper run or market hours pause it at a month boundary, and it refuses when the input data is not ready
jobs.name: compute-features

jobs.description: Alert on a raw NSE close that jumped more than 20% with no corporate action recorded (an action the parser could not price, or a missing one)
jobs.name: price-continuity

jobs.description: Compare the stored Kite daily candles with bhavcopy (database only: needs no Kite session)
jobs.name: kite-reconcile

jobs.description: Re-sweep the last 30 days for missing sessions
jobs.name: gap-nightly

jobs.description: Deep sweep from 2019-10 (resumable; loaded days are skipped)
jobs.name: gap-weekly

jobs.description: Sync the NSE holiday calendar
jobs.name: calendar-weekly

jobs.description: Security master, new listings, symbol changes and the Nifty 200 snapshot
jobs.name: universe-daily

jobs.description: Corporate actions for the whole market in one request (last 14 days to 120 days ahead): new ones join the table, announced future ones are listed; new ones that need a person are reported
jobs.name: corporate-actions-daily

jobs.description: Rebuild corporate actions from NSE's full history for every active equity (about 2 hours at a polite pace; resumes after a throttle): catches revisions made after an ex-date and anything the daily job missed
jobs.name: corporate-actions-monthly

jobs.description: Today's Kite daily candle for the mapped instruments (the -BE series are skipped; the close is provisional until the morning revise; exit 3 = session expired, 1 = some stock failed; alerted)
jobs.name: kite-daily-candles

jobs.description: Re-read the last week of Kite daily candles and keep the final values: yesterday's evening candle is provisional, a changed candle is stored as the next dataset version and the history is kept (also fills a missed day); frozen days are never touched
jobs.name: kite-daily-revise

jobs.description: Latest results (resumable sweep of recent filings), then the full set of figures
jobs.name: fundamentals-daily

jobs.description: Rebuild the stored stock-screener table from the day's bars and results (after both have loaded)
jobs.name: screener-refresh

jobs.description: Index total-return series (Nifty 50/200 and every broad, sector and thematic index) up to yesterday: capture, ingest, validate; a failed series alerts, the rest still load
jobs.name: benchmarks-daily

jobs.description: Store today's official index constituent lists in the lake
jobs.name: constituents-weekly

jobs.description: AMFI market-cap rankings (picks up the Jun/Dec lists when published; safe to repeat)
jobs.name: amfi-caps-monthly

jobs.description: Re-capture the official fee documents into the lake
jobs.name: cost-sources-monthly

jobs.description: Nightly database dump, 14 days kept (the lake is not backed up: needs a destination)
jobs.name: db-backup

jobs.description: Alert if the newest bar is behind the latest session
jobs.name: data-freshness

jobs.description: Alert when the disk holding the data is 90% full
jobs.name: disk-check
